At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Large Loss Contents Property Adjuster:

• You will be traveling to customer’s home to inspect large loss contents claims.
• Handle escalated claims files that have complex contents.
• Conduct a thorough coverage investigation of the loss and ensure the policy was applied correctly.
• You will be on site inspecting as well as using advanced video technology to collaborate with onsite vendors to identify damages and write a contents damage estimate.
• Communicate empathetically with customers and help them through their claim process in a fast, fair and easy manner.
• Negotiate claim settlements with customers in accordance with business unit standard methodologies.
• Coordinate with structure adjusters to ensure holistic handling of the claim file.
• Use data and analytics to tell a story and influence decision making.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

• The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Property claim. You lead with empathy, always.
• The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
• The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
• The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
• The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
• The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Preferred Qualifications:

• 3+ years of experience using estimating software like Xactimate for complex contents estimating.
• 3+ years of experience handling large loss property contents.
• Value providing an effortless customer service experience.
• You enjoy the ability to work independently starting your day from home.
• View problems and setbacks as opportunities for improvement and look forward to coming up with creative solutions.
• Are organized and able to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.
• Are known for clear and professional communication – both written and verbal.

Required Qualifications:

• Must have a valid driver’s license.

You’re provided with comprehensive training:

• The first approximately eight weeks of employment are dedicated to onboarding, licensing (if applicable), and role-specific training designed to prepare you for success in the role. Successful candidates must be able to attend required training sessions, actively participate in virtual learning activities, and successfully complete the training program.
• The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.
• Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.
• You will be required to attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

• As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
• As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Sign On Bonus:

• You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.
• Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Company Car:

• Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

• Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
• Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
• Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
• Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

The mission of the Foundation AI group is to enable Roblox Creators to accelerate their workflows and to put GenAI in the hands of millions of users. We envision a future in which experiences on Roblox leverage generative text and speech capabilities to enable new forms of interaction, generative 3D and 4D capabilities to enable new ways to create, and generative video to give creators a level of visual fidelity and motion that has never been available at this scale.

We shipped our 3D foundation model, which takes text prompts as input and generates production ready 3D objects and worlds. We are now building the Roblox Video Model; the Super Upsampler at the heart of Roblox Reality, our hybrid architecture that pairs the structured simulation of the Roblox Game Engine and Roblox Cloud with the photorealism of Video World Models. The engine stays the source of truth for the data model: state, physics, collision, logic, and multiplayer consistency. The video model generates the pixels: higher fidelity textures, realistic lighting, secondary motion, fluid dynamics, and the unscripted detail of a real world. A world model paired with our engine, enables persistent, multiplayer, photorealistic worlds that any creator can build and any player can join.

As the Senior/Principal Product Manager for Video Generation, your job is to put that in the hands of our community. You will take the Roblox Video Model out of the lab and into creator early access, then to a platform capability available to everyone, running on cloud edge GPU infrastructure, scaling toward tens of millions of concurrents, and keeping agency firmly with the creator. You will own the strategy and vision, define how creators direct and control the model.

You will:

• Build a vision and strategy for real-time video generation that delights creators and players and leads to industry-defining innovation in world models.
• Own the launch to our community — from lab demo, to creator early access, to scaled platform capability — and earn the trust of a community with real concerns about AI in creation by shipping in the open and proving the model serves them.
• Define the creator control surface: how creators condition, direct, and constrain the model so their game rules, art direction, and systems are never overridden.
• Deeply understand the model capabilities our creators need — temporal coherence, multiplayer consistency, avatar fidelity, prompt and style adherence — and shape the research roadmap against them.
• Develop comprehensive evaluation for our models, combining automated metrics with creator and player feedback, and own the quality, latency, and cost curve with research and infrastructure so this scales affordably.
• Work across the company — with engine, rendering, creator, safety, and economy — to make generated pixels safe, age-appropriate, and a core part of gameplay.
• Manage from vision through the product life cycle, prioritizing by working with creators and analyzing how our model is used, while providing insights to non-technical audiences and holding your own with world-class AI researchers.

You have:

• A track record of solving hard problems.
• Proven experience building, shipping, or supporting generative media products — video, image, or world models — or real-time rendering and graphics technology at scale.
• Experience productizing research: turning model capabilities into product and product signal back into research priorities, with fluency in the tradeoffs that define this space — quality, latency, inference cost, and compute.
• A deep understanding of the product life cycle and a history of collaborating with engineering teams and other stakeholders to deliver complex technical products on time.
• Experience shipping to large consumer or creator communities, ideally in gaming, UGC platforms, or creative tools.
• A Masters degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Graphics, 3D Animation, or Games Production, or a similar technical field.
• Passion for driving user-centric product decisions with an inclusive and strategic mindset, comfort in a fast-moving and ambiguous environment, and a high degree of independent drive.

Position Purpose: The Sr. Data Scientist, Experimentation Science owns the statistical foundation of how The Home Depot learns from its online customers. Every year the Online organization runs experiments that decide what ships, what gets rebuilt and what gets abandoned. This role makes those decisions trustworthy. You own the inference methods behind the results, the diagnostics that catch a broken test before anyone reads it, and the design guidance that gets product teams to a well-powered, well-instrumented experiment before a single customer is exposed. The work happens at two altitudes. At the methods altitude, you define and validate the statistical approach used across online experimentation: estimator choice, variance reduction, sequential testing, heterogeneous treatment effects, and causal inference where randomization is not possible. At the team altitude, you sit with product managers, engineers, designers and merchants to shape hypotheses, size effects honestly, and interpret results without overclaiming. You are the person who says the test cannot answer that question at this traffic, and the person who says this result is real and we should act on it. This role also builds the AI layer that scales the practice. Experimentation is full of high-volume, judgment-adjacent work: design review, instrumentation checks, readout drafting, anomaly triage. You will design, build and evaluate LLM-based and agentic workflows that absorb that work, so the team's scientists spend their time on the questions that need a human. That means writing the tooling, defining how it connects to our data and platforms, and holding it to an evaluation standard as rigorous as the one you apply to experiments. Success is measured by decision quality and experiment velocity together: more tests, faster, that leaders actually believe. This is a senior individual contributor role with broad technical influence, setting the standards that other data scientists and analysts across the Online organization follow. Key Responsibilities: 35% Solution Development - Proficiently design and develop algorithms and models to use against large datasets to create business insights; Execute tasks with high levels of efficiency and quality; Make appropriate selection, utilization and interpretation of advanced analytical methodologies; Effectively communicate insights and recommendations to both technical and non-technical leaders and business customers/partners; Prepare reports, updates and/or presentations related to progress made on a project or solution; Clearly communicate impacts of recommendations to drive alignment and appropriate implementation 30% Project Management & Team Support - Work with project teams and business partners to determine project goals; Provide direction on prioritization of work and ensure quality of work; Provide mentoring and coaching to more junior roles to support their technical competencies; Collaborate with managers and team in the distribution of workload and resources; Support recruiting and hiring efforts for the team 20% Business Collaboration - Leverage extensive business knowledge into solution approach; Effectively develop trust and collaboration with internal customers and cross-functional teams; Provide general education on advanced analytics to technical and non-technical business partners; Deep understanding of IT needs for the team to be successful in tackling business problems; Actively seek out new business opportunities to leverage data science as a competitive advantage 15% Technical Exploration & Development - Seek further knowledge on key developments within data science, technical skill sets, and additional data sources; Participate in the continuous improvement of data science and analytics by developing replicable solutions (for example, codified data products, project documentation, process flowcharts) to ensure solutions are leveraged for future projects; Define best practices and develop clear vision for data analysis and model productionalization; Contribute to library of reusable algorithms for future use, ensuring developed codes are documented Direct Manager/Direct Reports: This position reports to manager or above This position has 0 Direct Reports Travel Requirements: Typically requires overnight travel less than 10% of the time. Physical Requirements: Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions there may be a need to move or lift light articles. Working Conditions: Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable. Minimum Qualifications: Must be eighteen years of age or older. Must be legally permitted to work in the United States. Preferred Qualifications: Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Statistics, Economics, Biostatistics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics or a related quantitative field 6+ years of quantitative analytics experience, including hands-on ownership of online controlled experiments end to end Deep expertise in experimental design, hypothesis testing, power analysis and causal inference Working knowledge of variance reduction, sequential and always-valid testing, and heterogeneous treatment effect estimation Experience with quasi-experimental methods where randomization is not possible, such as difference-in-differences, synthetic control or geo-based design Proficiency in Python or R for statistical analysis, and in SQL against a cloud warehouse (preferably Google BigQuery) Experience building production or near-production workflows with LLMs, including prompt design, tool and function calling, retrieval, and multi-step or agentic orchestration Experience defining evaluation for AI systems, including offline benchmarks, human review loops and monitoring for regression Experience with modern experimentation platforms, including server-side testing and feature flag patterns Experience building or independently validating an experimentation statistics engine, not only consuming one Familiarity with e-commerce or retail metrics, including conversion, average order value, attach rate and lifetime value Demonstrated ability to explain statistical trade-offs and uncertainty to non-technical partners and senior leaders Experience mentoring analysts or data scientists and setting technical standards without formal authority Comfort with version control, collaborative code review and shipping internal tooling others depend on Minimum Education: The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a bachelor's degree program or equivalent degree in a field of study related to the job. Formulate relevant analytical frameworks to address key economic issues in device forecasting Science Communication & Collaboration 1. Explain complex science models and methodologies to non-technical stakeholders including product managers and marketing managers 2. Collaborate with economists, data scientists, and applied scientists across Decision Science 3. Present results of analyses to cross-functional teams and leadership 4. Riot engineers bring deep knowledge of specific technical areas but also value the opportunity to work in a variety of broader domains. We work with both new and current technology, creating innovative solutions to overcome high-volume obstacles and to deliver player value. As a Staff Software Engineer, you’ll drive important features and provide other engineers with a clear illustration of extraordinary engineering.

As a Staff Software Engineer, Console on an unpublished R&D product, you will lead the way on console development for one of Riot’s most exciting new games. You will work closely with other experts in engineering, QA, art and design to ensure the game is meeting the team’s creative and quality marks on multiple platforms. In this role you will be hands-on in developing and debugging core features of the game, integrating console-specific systems, delivering the gamepad experience, and addressing certification requirements. You will work with state-of-the-art technology, and explore new solutions to surprise and delight our players as we bring this new game to life. You will report to the Senior Engineering Manager of the Tech Foundations team within an R&D game project.

Responsibilities:

• Work closely with QA, engineers, designers and artists to understand and address the technical, creative and artistic requirements of the game on console
• Investigate, understand and solve complex technical problems specific to console
• Profile and optimize performance and memory usage on console platforms
• Integrate first party features for each console platform into the game
• Drive the implementation of technical certification requirements on each platform
• Participate in the planning and execution of engineering work for console including requirements gathering, technical discovery, work breakdown and estimation
• Drive exceptional quality by adhering to and evolving the team’s practices of engineering excellence, including code maintainability, quality, monitoring, code reviews, and documentation
• Provide mentorship to new engineers as the team scales, and provide feedback that supports their technical growth

Required Qualifications:

• 8+ years of professional experience in software engineering, including experience delivering live or shipped products at scale
• 3+ years experience working on console-specific game development
• Experience shipping one or more console platform titles
• Experience in performance profiling and optimization on console
• Experience implementing TCRs/TRCs for one or more console platforms
• Proven ability to navigate ambiguity and solve complex problems with minimal support
• Experience collaborating with teammates across multiple disciplines
• Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences

Desired Qualifications:

• Experience building multiplayer games
• Experience implementing or porting UI on console platforms
• Experience implementing the gamepad experience for one or more console games

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise and a collaborative spirit that prioritizes the delight of players. We will look at your past studies and experience, but for this role, we also look for dedicated people with a personal relationship with games. Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. At Riot Games, we put players first. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.

회사 소개

쿠팡이츠(Coupang Eats)는 음식배달을 시작으로 장보기와 쇼핑까지 서비스 영역을 확장하며 고객의 일상을 더욱 편리하게 만드는 새로운 경험을 만들어가고 있습니다. 고객에게 더 나은 경험을 제공하기 위한 끊임없는 고민을 바탕으로 도전하며, 새로운 서비스와 카테고리의 변화를 이끌고 있습니다.

쿠팡이츠는 스스로 기회를 만들고 결과를 만들어낸 구성원에게 더 큰 역할과 책임을 부여하고 있습니다. 자신의 아이디어를 실행으로 옮기고, 성과를 통해 더 큰 기회를 만들어가며, 비즈니스의 성장을 직접 이끄는 성취감을 경험할 수 있습니다.

분야별 전문가들과 더 큰 도전을 통해 함께 성장하고 싶다면, 지금 쿠팡이츠와 함께하세요.

직무 소개

쿠팡이츠 PDC(Partner Development & Conversion) 팀은 마켓 지표와 내부 데이터베이스를 활용해 파트너 파이프라인을 발굴하고 전략적 파트너 직접 유치를 실행하는 B2B 세일즈 및 파트너십 조직입니다. 포괄적인 신규 셀렉션 유치를 통해 전체 비즈니스의 성장(Acquisition)을 견인하며, 특히 주요 프랜차이즈 파트너와의 소통을 일원화하는 전용 핫라인(Hotline) 채널을 구축하고 운영하여 비즈니스 내 핵심 셀렉션을 극대화합니다. 이를 기반으로 매끄러운 온보딩 경험을 제공하고 긴밀한 브랜드 파트너십을 관리하여 장기적인 비즈니스 시너지를 창출합니다. 우리는 데이터를 기반으로 타깃을 명확히 하고, 확실한 컨버전(Conversion)을 만들어내는 실행력 중심의 팀입니다.

업무 내용

• 데이터 기반 Top Brand 및 Selection 타깃 발굴: 마켓 지표 및 내부 DB를 분석하여 성장 가능성 높은 주요 프랜차이즈 브랜드 세그먼트 및 우선순위 타깃 발굴
• 브랜드 파트너 직접 유치 & 컨버전 주도: 주요 프랜차이즈 HQ 파트너십을 구축하고, 신규 및 양도양수 가맹점 대상의 선제적 제안 및 전략적 파트너 직접 유치 파이프라인 운영
• 전용 상담 채널 및 운영 인력 관리: 브랜드 파트너 전용 인바운드/아웃바운드 소통 채널(핫라인) 구축, 운영 인력의 업무 배분, 일정 및 결과물(Deliverables) 퀄리티 관리
• 파트너십 및 온보딩 프로젝트 관리 (PM): 파트너 전용 혜택(패스트트랙 등)을 통한 자사 채널 옵트인(Opt-in) 유도 전략 수립 및 핵심 KPI(매출 기여도, 채널 전환율 등) 트래킹

자격 요건

• 5년 이상 B2B Account Management, B2B 세일즈, 혹은 채널 운영 PM 경력을 보유하신 분
• 데이터 분석 역량을 기반으로 마켓 및 파트너 타깃을 발굴하고, 적극적인 아웃바운드 및 세일즈 컨버전 성과를 창출해 본 경험이 있으신 분
• 콜센터, 상담 채널, CX 인프라 등 B2B 지원 조직의 운영 프로세스 수립 및 인력/실적 관리 경험이 있으신 분

우대 사항

• 참고사항

개인정보 처리방침

jobs.description: An exciting career awaits you At MPC, we’re committed to being a great place to work – one that welcomes new ideas, encourages diverse perspectives, develops our people, and fosters a collaborative team environment. POSITION SUMMARY: Marathon Petroleum Company is seeking a Process Control Manager at the Martinez Renewable Fuels Facility. This role is responsible for leading the Process Control team that supports safe, reliable, and efficient facility operations through process automation, control systems, and optimization. The Process Control Manager will oversee team performance, establish priorities, support the technical execution of process control initiatives, and foster employees’ ongoing professional development. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Plans, manages, and directs activities of a group of engineers and technicians that ensure the regulatory process control, advanced control optimization, and safety system automation needs of the refinery are met. Provides technical leadership and directs technical resources during all modes of refinery operation including normal, upset and emergency, turnaround coverage/direction, and startup/shutdown activities. Provides technical guidance related to controller function and expert troubleshooting of controller, equipment, and system issues. Ensures adherence to process control policies/procedures and process control refining standard practices. Provides direct oversight and independent review of critical controller design and installation activities. Ensures all management of change, process safety, and regulatory compliance requirements are met. Advises and directs engineers on monitoring the health and performance of regulatory controls, advanced process controls used for process optimization, and PLCs used for complex automation, equipment protection, and emergency shutdown systems. Collaborates with other departments and disciplines to develop repair/redesign options to address acute or chronic operating problems. Directs resources in the planning and execution phases of turnarounds, where responsibilities include controller loop checking, network and control systems upgrades, PLC program testing and modifications, and implementation of process control and automation projects. Serves as the liaison between OT resources, Process Controls, and Operations to ensure risks of any planned updates, upgrades, or replacements are considered and mitigated so that OT work can be executed without impacting the safe, reliable operation of the running refinery. Advises engineers as they collaborate with Operations, Commercial, and Process Engineering to design/build controllers to ensure stable and optimized refinery operation against known constraints. Advises and directs engineers in developing step tests to assess process response to manipulated variables, applying and adjusting tuning constants, and modifying controller configurations. Directs engineers in making sound investment decisions with robust economic justification in support of their recommendations. Manages control systems replacements for obsolescence. Works with supply chain to manage system/PLC parts inventory. Manages local process control testing facility and directs testing of vendor control platform updates. Communicates with leadership, peer supervisors, and other stakeholders to align on priorities and resource allocation. Prepares progress reports and decision support presentations for management to communicate accomplishments, justify recommendations, and elevate risks/concerns. Participates in department-wide responsibilities (preparing/managing department budget; preparing/managing controls/PLC budgets; department staffing decisions, including recruiting, interviewing, and selection of candidates; university campus engagement; maintaining working relationships with third-party licensors, technology vendors, control systems suppliers, and engineering contractors). MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: Associate's Degree required. Five (5) years or more relevant experience. Valid Driver's License is required upon hire. Must be able to obtain a TWIC Card. ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

THE ROLE

This role exists to ensure the physical safety, regulatory compliance, and operational resilience of Mistral's HQ.

As a member of the global security team, you will shape and execute the HQ's physical security strategy for one of the world’s leading AI companies, directly impacting the protection of employees, assets, and intellectual property. Your work will establish Mistral's HQ as a benchmark for physical security in the tech sector, enabling business growth while mitigating risks in a cutting-edge, AI-driven environment.

You will own the end-to-end physical security framework—from access control and surveillance to crisis response—collaborating closely with French authorities (Police, Gendarmerie, ANSSI) and internal stakeholders. This is a unique opportunity to build a scalable, compliant, and innovative security model that sets the standard for Mistral's expansion across Europe.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Define and implement a unified physical security strategy for Mistral AI’s France facilities, aligning global policies with local regulations.

- Lead the consolidation and management of security vendors under SLAs, ensuring performance, cost-efficiency, and compliance.

- Establish a regulatory compliance program to achieve 100% adherence to French/EU laws (CNIL, RGPD, NIS2) and industry standards (ISO 27001/28000).

- Deploy state-of-the-art security technologies, including AI-powered surveillance, access control, and intrusion detection systems.

- Develop and test crisis response frameworks, including emergency protocols for evacuations, lockdowns, and high-impact incidents.

- Formalize liaison protocols with French authorities to enable threat intelligence sharing and collaborative security measures.

- Optimize the France security budget (€1M–3M/year) through vendor consolidation, efficiency gains, and risk-based prioritization.

- Measure and report on security performance, ensuring zero major incidents and continuous improvement of safety standards.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Proven experience designing and implementing physical security programs for large, high-stakes facilities or multi-site operations.

- Vendor management expertise with a track record of consolidating, negotiating, and optimizing security service contracts (e.g., guard services, CCTV, access control).

- Crisis leadership with hands-on experience developing and testing emergency response protocols for incidents like protests, cyber-physical threats, or natural disasters.

- Deep knowledge of French/EU compliance frameworks (CNIL, RGPD, NIS2, ISO 27001/28000) and a history of leading audits or certifications.

- Builder mentality—thrives in ambiguous environments, turning strategy into scalable, operational security solutions.

- Data-driven decision-making—uses KPIs, risk assessments, and metrics to continuously improve security posture.

- Resilience under pressure—maintains clarity and effectiveness in high-stakes, fast-evolving situations.

- Uncompromising integrity—upholds the highest ethical standards, ensuring confidentiality and trust in sensitive contexts.

WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link.
